gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: For 2015, Syndicate 1200 reported an overall net prior year reserve release of GBP 16.4 million, representing approximately 6.0% of its opening net claims outstanding. This release is described as an "overall improvement" in claims provisions. While the year was benign for natural catastrophes, the 2014 year of account experienced higher than anticipated large losses in the Marine & Energy and Property Direct & Facultative divisions, leading to some reserve strengthening for those lines. However, these were partly offset by continued positive developments in the North American Binders and Aviation books, contributing to the net release. The syndicate's gross written premiums for 2015 totaled GBP 421.5 million, with significant contributions from Third party liability, Fire and other damage to property, and Reinsurance acceptances.
